title: 12 to 24 months, and the phase people skip is depth
takeaway: Reaching employable takes 12 to 24 months; depth in months 9 to 14 separates the hired from tutorial finishers.
sources: The phase people skip is the third one, and it is the one that separates people who get hired from people who have completed a lot of tutorials.
Bootcamp claims of "job-ready in 12 weeks" describe when the classroom ends, not when someone pays you.
There is no shortcut, and the people who make it are not the fastest learners - they are the ones still going in month fourteen when it stopped being novel and had not yet started paying.
